title: Mine AAA Shrek Edition
description: Random things i made to not be bored
body:
This resource/texture pack adds:

A custom background image, splash text and title for the main menu.

Custom clouds shaped like Sans the skeleton.

Custom comparator textures so you know if it is in compare or subtract mode.

Custom redstone lamp textures without the ugly lines in the middle.

Animated bucket of axolotl that blinks.

Custom carved pumkin overlay when you wear it.

Custom hotbar and gamemode switcher that looks more transparent and consistently colored.
